note: Tools the bootstrap builds download, pinned by URL and SHA-256. A download that does not match its pin is discarded and the artifact is skipped with APPIMAGE_SKIPPED (Linux) or INSTALLER_SKIPPED (Windows); nothing unpinned is ever executed. Update a pin only after checking the new release's own checksums.

appimageRuntime.note: The runtime that mounts the image. Pinned to upstream's dated release, not its rolling 'continuous' release, which is rebuilt on every upstream push and so changes the hash behind a fixed URL. Upstream publishes no checksum file for this release; each hash was computed from the release asset, equals the digest GitHub records for that asset, and the asset's detached signature (runtime-<arch>.sig) verifies against signing-pubkey.asc in the upstream repository (key 570C77ACEA40C0F1B758902CBF96CCA56490F695). To take a newer runtime, move to a newer dated release on purpose and repeat those checks.

winsw.note: The Windows service host (WinSW, .NET Framework 4.x build: runs on a stock Windows 10/11 and Server 2016+). Upstream publishes no checksum for this release; the hash was computed from the release asset and cross-checked against independent Scoop package manifests that pin the same file. The helper (apps/manager/privileged/win32.js) compares the executable against windowsServiceXml.WINSW before it registers anything; tests/windowsService.test.js keeps the two equal.
